label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verse: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
note: Hand over the whole road, not just the next step — then trust him to bring it to pass.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall _____; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verse: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
note: Luke puts this right after a parable about a friend knocking at midnight for bread — persistence pays.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in _____, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
verse: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
note: The KJV spells it 'morter' — Israel's lives made bitter with brick and mortar under Egypt's taskmasters.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and _____, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verse: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
note: Gentiles once outside the fence are now citizens and household — Paul piles on the welcome.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou hast made us as the _____ and refuse in the midst of the people.
verse: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
note: Jerusalem made 'the offscouring and refuse' among nations — Paul uses the same word for the apostles in 1 Corinthians 4:13.
